_comment: W2. THE ONE DESCRIPTION OF WHAT `jev install` REGISTERS. Read by src/install.py (which writes it into a target repo's ./.claude/settings.local.json) and by tests/reversibility.sh (which materialises a fixture registration from it when no live one exists, and which requires every script named here to carry BOTH canonical kill-switch blocks). A second, hand-written copy of this list is exactly the drift the actuator fixture in reversibility.sh was written to avoid, so there is one copy and both readers use it.
_marker: How an entry of ours is recognised in somebody else's settings file at uninstall time: its command is EXACTLY the absolute path $JEV_HOME/<script> below, or exactly a command this repo's own .claude/jev-install.json records having written. Never a substring -- W5 found that `script in command` claimed somebody else's /my/own/hooks/agent_route_actuator.sh --mine and `jev install` deleted it in silence. Structural, not a magic key inside the hooks array: Claude Code parses that array and an unknown key there is not ours to add.
_not_armed: Listing an entry here does NOT arm it -- but `config/surfaces.json` is NOT what keeps it unarmed, and this note said otherwise until 2026-09-21. CORRECTION: `surfaces.agent_route.mode` is NEVER READ by hooks/agent_route_actuator.sh, nor by src/install.py, which registers from THIS file alone. It gates nothing in the routing path; setting it to `shadow` or `off` changes no behaviour whatsoever. What actually keeps the actuator inert is exactly two things: (a) no entry for it in the routed project's .claude/settings.local.json, and (b) the kill switches ($JEV_HOME/.jev-disabled, $ROOT/.jev-disabled, $HOME/.claude/jev-disabled). THERE IS NO SHADOW MODE FOR THIS ACTUATOR: registering it IS arming it, once no switch is set. JEV-34's record-only agent_route surface is the capture.sh/spool path, a different script that does not write data/agent_route/assignments/. Arming is a separate deliberate act (JEV-52), performed by registering the entry and clearing the switch, and by nothing else.
